name: Nova Plus

Body.Other: Fingerprint scanner (rear-mounted), proximity sensor, accelerometer, compass

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 6.0.1 Marshmallow + EMUI 4.1, Current: Android 7.0 Nougat + EMUI 5
Platform.CPU: Qualcomm MSM8953 Snapdragon 625 (14 nm), 8x2.0 GHz Cortex-A53

Memory.RAM: Nova Plus: 3 GB, G9 Plus & Maimang 5: 3/4 GB
Memory.Storage: Nova Plus: 32 GB, G9 Plus & Maimang 5: 32/64 GB, eMMC 5.1

Cameras.Rear camera: 16 MP, f/2.0, 1/2.8", 1.12μm, PDAF, OIS, 2-LED dual-tone flash, HDR, panorama, Video: 4K@30fps, 1080p@30fps
